translation.name: Biblica® Wɔnhia ɛho kwamma nwoma Asante Twi Nkwa Asɛm

content.text: Edin pa yɛ sene ahonya bebrebe;
sɛ wɔbɛdi wo ni yɛ sene dwetɛ anaa sikakɔkɔɔ.
Ɔdefoɔ ne ohiani wɔ adeɛ baako,
Awurade ne wɔn nyinaa Yɛfoɔ.
Onitefoɔ hunu amanehunu a ɛreba na ɔhinta ne ho,
nanso atetekwaa kɔ nʼanim kɔnya amane.
Ahobrɛaseɛ ne Awurade suro
ma ahonya ne animuonyam ne nkwa.
Nkasɛɛ ne mfidie wɔ amumuyɛfoɔ akwan so,
nanso deɛ ɔbɔ ne kra ho ban no mmɛn ho.
Kyerɛ abɔfra ɛkwan a ɔmfa so,
na sɛ ɔnyini a ɔremfiri so.
Adefoɔ di ahiafoɔ so,
na boseagyeni yɛ deɛ ɔde fɛm ɔsomfoɔ.
Deɛ ɔdua amumuyɛsɛm no twa ɔhaw
na wɔbɛsɛe nʼabufuhyeɛ abaa.
Ɔyamyɛfoɔ bɛnya nhyira
ɛfiri sɛ ɔne ahiafoɔ kyɛ nʼaduane.
Pam ɔfɛdifoɔ na basabasayɛ nso bɛkɔ;
ntɔkwa ne atɛnnidie to atwa.
Obi a ɔdɔ akoma a emu teɛ na ne kasa ho yɛ nyam
bɛnya ɔhene afa no adamfo.
Awurade ani wɛn nimdeɛ,
na ɔsɛe ɔtorofoɔ nsɛm.
Ɔkwadwofoɔ ka sɛ, “Gyata bi wɔ mfikyire hɔ!”
anaasɛ, “Wɔbɛkum me wɔ mmɔntene so.”
Ɔbaa waresɛefoɔ anomu yɛ amena donkudonku;
deɛ ɔhyɛ Awurade abufuo ase no bɛtɔ mu.
Agyimisɛm kyekyere abɔfra akoma ho,
nanso ntenesoɔ abaa bɛpamo akɔ akyiri.
Obi bɛsisi ohiani de apɛ ahonya
anaa ɔbɛkyɛ ɔdefoɔ adeɛ, ne nyinaa de no kɔ ohia mu.
Yɛ aso na tie anyansasɛm yi;
fa wʼakoma di me nkyerɛkyerɛ akyi,
ɛfiri sɛ ɛyɛ sɛ wokora saa nsɛm yi wɔ wʼakoma mu,
na ne nyinaa ada wʼano.
Sɛdeɛ wode wo ho bɛto Awurade so,
merekyerɛkyerɛ wo ɛnnɛ, aane wo.
Mentwerɛɛ mmɛ aduasa mmaa wo,
deɛ ɛyɛ afotusɛm ne nimdeɛ,
a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ wo nokorɛ ne deɛ akyinnyeɛ nni ho,
sɛdeɛ wobɛnya mmuaeɛ pa ama deɛ ɔsomaa woɔ no anaa?
Mmɔ ahiafoɔ korɔno, sɛ wɔyɛ ahiafoɔ enti,
na nnsisi wɔn a wɔnni bie wɔ asɛnniiɛ,
ɛfiri sɛ Awurade bɛdi wɔn asɛm ama wɔn
na wafom afa wɔn a wɔfom ahiafoɔ fa.
Mfa obi a ne bo ha no adamfo,
na mmfa wo ho mmɔ deɛ ne bo nkyɛre fu,
anyɛ saa a, wobɛsua nʼakwan
na woakɔtɔ afidie mu.
Ɛnyɛ deɛ ɔde ne nsa hyɛ krataa ase di agyinamu,
anaasɛ deɛ ɔdi akagyinamu;
na sɛ wonni deɛ wɔde tua a
wɔbɛhwan wo mpa mpo afiri wʼase.
Ntutu tete aboɔ a wɔde ato hyeɛ;
deɛ wo nananom de sisii hɔ no.
Wohunu odwumayɛfoɔ a ne nsa akokwa nʼadwuma ho anaa?
Ahemfo anim na ɔbɛsom,
na ɔrensom wɔ mpapahwekwaa anim.
